messages.subject: Plotting dates
parts:
Hi Guys/Gals

I am plotting two dates and having problems.  I'd like the years to appear on the two axes.  Additionally, I'd like to vary the color of the points based on a continuous variable (not reflected in my example.)  Can someone help please?

Troy

df <- data.frame(
a=as.Date(c('1/1/2001', '6/7/2002'), format='%m/%d/%Y'),
b=as.Date(c('1/11/2002', '6/7/2004'), format='%m/%d/%Y'))
qplot(a, b, data=df)+scale_x_datetime(format='%y')+scale_y_datetime(format='%y')

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Plotting dates
parts:
Hi Troy,

Something like the following should do the trick:

qplot(a, b, data=df) +
scale_x_date(format='%y', major = "1 year") +
scale_y_date(format='%y', major = "1 year")

Hadley
